operating_notes.text: Heavy Engineering segment EBIT was ₹11.02 Cr in Q4FY26 against a ₹45.24 Cr loss a year earlier, on revenue of ₹75.99 Cr.
Foundry and Machine Shop revenue fell to ₹13.67 Cr in FY26 from ₹36.98 Cr in FY25, with segment EBIT of -₹3.13 Cr.
ESOP Scheme 2020 expense of ₹241 lakh was recognised in Q4FY26 employee benefits expense.
WIP of ₹0.92 Cr remains on books for a custom cement-plant machine after ₹15.65 Cr impairment in previous financial years, following CIRP admission against customer JUD Cements Limited.

timeline.summary: Q4FY26 results (standalone): revenue ₹93.02 Cr (+75.2% YoY), net profit ₹2.94 Cr (against a loss of ₹56.12 Cr a year earlier).
Walchandnagar Industries issued a press release highlighting its FY26 EBITDA turnaround to ₹35.48 Cr.

On 22 October 2026, Walchandnagar Industries disclosed that NCLT Guwahati admitted CIRP against customer JUD Cements on 12 October 2026, with ₹0.92 Cr of already-impaired WIP for undelivered machinery still in its custody.
